content:
Endive 1.1.0 is out :tada:

Two things I am happy about in this one.
redline, the Cranelift based native compiler, now lives in the main tree and is usable from the compiler plugin.
And we are using inlay(based on wkg) to fetch Wasm modules from OCI registries, digests locked and signatures verified, for our own build as well as yours.

https://endive.run/blog/endive-1.1.0

If you try redline I would really like to hear how it goes!
